long_biography.plain_text:
GVG Andresen was established in Hamburg in 1978, when Andresen was still a teenager. He later became its sole shareholder and long-serving managing director, guiding the family office around its owner family's property portfolio. The business buys, lets and manages commercial assets across Germany, with particular emphasis on prime retail locations, food-anchored stores and hotels, while undertaking refurbishment and selected development work.

Andresen stepped back from GVG's executive management in 2023 as Gina Andresen became managing director, but he remains the company's owner and maintains other investment-company roles in Germany and Liechtenstein. Those holdings include Andresen Beteiligungsgesellschaft and Immohome, which held a Palm Beach residence for fourteen years before its sale. His career is defined by long-term stewardship of a private, cross-border property platform rather than a single development or transaction.
